تعتمدين (form VIII)
# تَعْتَمِدِينَ (taʕtamidīna) /taʕ.ta.mi.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# تُعْتَمَدِينَ (tuʕtamadīna) /tuʕ.ta.ma.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
